csv_scope_of_work: ouglas County Transportation and Land Services (County) is soliciting Statements of Qualification (SOQ's) from consulting firms with expertise in bridge design, maintenance, repair, load rating, and inspections. This solicitation is conducted in accordance with RCW 39.80 (Qualifications Based Selection for Architectura and Engineering Services). FIRM SERVICES The scope of services to be performed under the on-call services contract generally may consist of, but not be limited to: 1) Performing load ratings, including but not limited updating existing load ratings to incorporate the new WA-105 truck configuration and evaluating and providing recommendations for Special Motor Vehicle Permits related to bridge capacity 2) Performing bridge inspections. 3) Completing design for emergency structural repairs or improvements. 4) Performing scour appraisal/analyses. 5) SNBI compliance assessments. 6) Completing feasibility studies. 7) Completing planning studies. 8) Assist in preparation of funding applications. 9) Providing peer review of Bridge Plans, Structural Calculation, specifications, and construction cost estimates
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Feasibility Studies, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
csv_comments: '- Project Number: TLS26-26A- Solicitation documents available online.- Questions Deadline: Submit questions online by 05/28/2026 05:00 PM PDT Up to two (2) Contracts May be awarded
title: Douglas County Bridge Consulting Services
short_description: On-call bridge consulting for inspections, load ratings, repairs, and studies in Douglas County.
project_scope: On-call countywide bridge consulting services for Douglas County Transportation and Land Services, including bridge design support, maintenance and repair consulting, load ratings updated for the WA-105 truck configuration, bridge inspections, emergency structural repair or improvement design, scour appraisals and analyses, SNBI compliance assessments, feasibility and planning studies, funding application support, and peer review of bridge plans, structural calculations, specifications, and construction cost estimates. Up to two renewable contracts may be awarded with a 24-month base period and 36-month renewal option.
services: Qualifications-based selection for on-call bridge engineering services: structural engineering, bridge inspections, load rating, emergency repair design, scour analysis, SNBI compliance, feasibility and planning studies, funding support, and peer review of bridge documents and estimates.
relevance_explanation:
- Bridge-related engineering services are generally relevant to sbp.
- Includes structural tasks such as load rating, inspections, emergency repair design, and peer review.
- However, this is a broad on-call framework-style county consulting contract rather than a defined, structurally ambitious bridge project.
- No specific bridge type, span, or architecturally demanding structure is identified.
- Includes several lower-priority service elements such as feasibility studies, planning studies, and funding support.
- Potentially useful for local bridge engineering presence, but limited strategic fit compared with landmark or complex bridge projects.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is for on-call consulting services covering inspections, ratings, studies, and possible emergency repair design across multiple bridge tasks, so no realistic single construction cost can be derived from the provided information.
fee_explanation: No fee, estimated contract value, or engineering budget is stated in the notice. The procurement is a qualifications-based on-call services contract with up to two awards, a 24-month base period, and a 36-month renewal option.
references_qualifications: Consulting firms must demonstrate expertise in bridge design, maintenance, repair, load rating, and inspections. Requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, feasibility studies, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering.
award_criteria: Qualifications-based selection under RCW 39.80 for architectural and engineering services; detailed weighting is not provided in the source.
contracting_authority: Douglas County Public Works / Douglas County Transportation and Land Services, East Wenatchee, WA, USA. Contact: Jennifer Lange. Phone: 509-884-7173. Email: jlange@co.douglas.wa.us. Website: https://www.douglascountywa.gov/bids.aspx?bidID=103
notes: Project number TLS26-26A. Questions deadline: 2026-05-28 05:00 PM PDT. Up to two contracts may be awarded. Renewable contract with 24-month base period and 36-month renewal option. The source describes an on-call bridge consulting solicitation rather than a single defined bridge project.
